items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
items.q: And Adrienne. Adrienne Rudolph. Rudolph. But Martha Saison is the star at Xavier Nair. She plays in all the concerts. Yeah. And so her father is a member with my husband of his lodge. And so he was so glad to ask his daughter. So we had a big concert instead of a tea.

ctx.x: No, there are two good singers. We had one singer. Martha Saison. Martha Saison, that's right.

And Adrienne. Adrienne Rudolph. Rudolph. But Martha Saison is the star at Xavier Nair. She plays in all the concerts. Yeah. And so her father is a member with my husband of his lodge. And so he was so glad to ask his daughter. So we had a big concert instead of a tea. Everybody was sitting down. They were very much enjoyed by the tea we had.
I'd like to ask you about that very first year. What kind of music did you have when you said it was in Congo Square with some people called Borrigan?
